scope: Exactly16 per-parent source units for duplicate I-block ACK and ISO-DEP Rules12/13. Last-Link cache observed separately; mixed WTX/TXEN hunk19 remains unapproved.
mapping: Ordinal37 acknowledges a repeated incoming block without a duplicate append, including empty chained frames; Rust Link::receive_with uses Receiving phase, not byte count.
Ordinal48 ignores opposite-BN unsolicited ACK unless an outgoing response chain is active; Rust returns Event::Ignored without resetting selection/input.
Ordinal49 handles opposite-BN NAK with control ACK before response advancement; Rust advances only positive ACK in Responding phase.
Ordinal50 sends current-BN ACK and resets retries; Rust acknowledge caches that ACK without moving the source or number.
Final pinned C caches every successfully transmitted packet. Rust now caches Link ACKs as well as I-blocks. WTX uses a separate IRQ-local path; no WTX cache/IRQ equivalence is claimed.
remaining: Mixed hunk19 combines caching, cleanup and TXEN ordering; it is not approved here. Physical RF/WTX, arbitrary IRQ/cancellation, file-fault breadth, runtime resources and broader source audit remain open.
